_comment: MANUAL BUILD SPEC - GHL has NO workflow write API (GET /workflows/ returns metadata only). These are built in the UI. The base snapshot ships 8 numbered workflows bound to the pipeline; renumber and rebuild against the event-rental stages rather than starting from zero.
_audit_first: The patio build found NINE real bugs in this same base snapshot: wrong trigger stages, a vendor's brand spoken in call whispers, their email on internal notifications, a misspelled merge field blanking phone numbers in six emails, and six emails promising a discount that did not exist. AUDIT every inherited workflow before trusting it. Assume the same bugs are present here.

workflows.name: 1. New Inquiry - Fast Five
workflows.trigger: Form submitted / inbound SMS / Facebook lead / missed call
workflows._why: Research: 78% of buyers pick the first responder and 74% of businesses miss the 5-minute window. This is the single highest-ROI workflow in the account.
steps: IMMEDIATE SMS: acknowledge by name, confirm we got the date they asked about, ask the two missing qualifiers. Never confirm availability (guardrail 1).
IMMEDIATE internal notification to {{custom_values.internal_notification_phone}} and {{custom_values.internal_notification_email}}
Tag book-date-requested
Create opportunity in 'New Inquiry'
+5 min: if no reply, second SMS
+1 hr / +1 day / +3 days: escalating follow-ups
Day 4: mark cold, drop into nurture (research: ~4 business day recovery window)
guardrails: Must NOT state availability, price, or deposit.

workflows.name: 2. Date Request - Operator Confirmation
workflows._why: THE workflow that implements the client's operator-controlled booking requirement. Customers never self-book; this routes the request to a human and chases the human, not the customer.
steps: Create task for owner: 'Check unit calendar for {{contact.event_date}}' due in 2 hours
If no operator response in 4 hrs during business hours: escalate SMS to owner
Operator outcome A -> tag book-date-available -> fire workflow 3
Operator outcome B -> tag book-date-conflict -> fire workflow 4

workflows.name: 3. Date Available - Quote & Agreement
steps: SMS + email: date looks good, here is your quote
Set Quote Sent Date, tag book-quote-sent, move to 'Quote Sent / Follow-Up'
Follow-up at +1 day, +3 days, +7 days if Agreement Status is still 'Not sent'
On agreement send: tag book-agreement-sent, move to 'Agreement Sent - AWAITING SIGNATURE'
guardrails: Copy must state the date is NOT held until signed + deposit paid.

workflows.name: 4. Date Conflict - Save the Booking
workflows._why: A taken date is not a lost customer if they are flexible. Reads Event Date Flexible? - this is why that field exists.
steps: If Event Date Flexible? != 'Locked in': offer two or three alternate dates
If 'Locked in': thank them warmly, tag qual-date-unavailable, add to nurture for next year
Never explain WHY the date is unavailable (do not disclose other bookings)

workflows.name: 5. Agreement Signed - Deposit Invoice
workflows._why: The client's explicit ask: 'have the deposit invoice auto send to the customer once we book the date ourselves'.
steps: Send deposit invoice / payment link {{custom_values.payment_link}}
Set Deposit Status = Requested, tag book-deposit-requested
Move to 'Signed - Deposit Invoice Sent'
Reminder at +2 days and +5 days if unpaid
+7 days unpaid: internal alert - the date is still NOT held

workflows.name: 6. Deposit Paid - DATE HELD
workflows._why: The booking moment. Everything before this is a soft hold.
steps: Confirmation SMS + email: date is now reserved
Tag book-deposit-paid + book-confirmed, move to 'Deposit Paid - DATE HELD'
TASK for operator: block the event on the EVENT - Unit Booking calendar
Set Balance Due Date = Event Date minus {{custom_values.balance_due_days_before_event}}
If Indoor or Outdoor = Outdoor -> tag risk-outdoor-event, enroll in workflow 8
If COI Requested? = Yes - pending -> task the operator immediately (carrier lead time is real)
workflows._critical: The calendar block is a TASK, not an automation - GHL cannot create the appointment on a service calendar from a workflow reliably. Do not let this be forgotten; it is the actual double-booking guard.

workflows.name: 7. Pre-Event Readiness
workflows._why: Every risk-* tag is a booking that can fail on event day. This chases them down before the day, not on it.
steps: T-10 days: chase any unresolved risk-space-unconfirmed / risk-power-unconfirmed / risk-permit-unresolved / risk-coi-pending
T-7 days: 'what to expect' email - load-in, timing, what we need from you; first balance reminder if Balance Status != Paid
T-4 days: balance reminder if still unpaid ({{custom_values.balance_due_days_before_event}} days before = the due date)
T-2 days (BALANCE DUE): confirm start time, venue address and on-site contact; balance due-today message if unpaid; set Balance Status = Due
T-1 day: if still unpaid set Balance Status = Overdue, tag book-balance-overdue, internal alert - operator decides whether to charge the card on file
workflows.note: Balance is due {{custom_values.balance_due_days_before_event}} days before the event (e.g. 2 = 48 hours). Balance CAPTURE is manual by design - the customer clicks pay or the operator charges the card on file. Copy must not promise automatic charging.

workflows.name: 8. Outdoor Weather Watch
workflows.trigger: Tag risk-outdoor-event AND stage = Booked - Pre-Event Prep
workflows._why: Research #6: documented decision points are T-72h, T-24h and an event-morning go/no-go.
steps: T-72h: task operator to check the forecast
T-24h: task operator; if concerning, set Weather Risk Flag = Watching forecast and move to 'Weather Hold / At Risk'
Event morning 7am: go/no-go task
Customer messaging on weather is MANUAL - the operator writes it
guardrails: No automated message may make a weather call or promise a refund or rain check (rules 11-15).

workflows.name: 9. Post-Event - Review & Referral
workflows._why: Research #9: T+48h review request bundled with a time-bound referral offer.
steps: T+4 hrs: thank-you SMS
T+48 hrs: review request with {{custom_values.google_review_link}}, tag ops-review-requested
T+5 days: second ask if no review
T+7 days: referral ask - ONLY if {{custom_values.referral_offer}} is filled in
If Repeat Customer? = 'Annual / recurring event': set Annual Event Month, tag src-annual-event
guardrails: If Referral Offer is blank the referral step must be SKIPPED, not sent with an empty promise. This is the exact bug the patio base shipped.

workflows.name: 10. Annual Rebooking
workflows.trigger: Tag src-annual-event, T+8 months after event
workflows._why: Research #10 and the highest-ROI automation for recurring corporate, school and fundraiser accounts. Reaches out 3-4 months before the same date next year.
steps: Warm email referencing last year's event by name and date
Tag ops-rebooking-outreach
Two follow-ups at +7 and +21 days
Create a new opportunity in 'New Inquiry' on any reply

workflows.name: 11. Lost Quote Reactivation
workflows.trigger: Quote Sent Date > 30 days AND no agreement signed
workflows._why: Mined from the Roofing pack: dead quotes are the cheapest pipeline in any trade.
steps: Check in referencing their original event date
If the date has passed: pivot to 'planning anything else this year?'
Tag ops-lost-quote-reactivation

workflows.name: 12. Human Handover
workflows.trigger: Tag ops-human-handover (set by the AI agent)
workflows._why: The AI is instructed to escalate 10 different ways but nothing currently RECEIVES the escalation. Same gap the patio build found.
steps: Immediate SMS + email to the operator with the AI Conversation Summary
Create task due in 1 hour
If untouched in 2 business hours: escalate again

workflows.name: 13. Missed Call Text Back
workflows._why: Event inquiries go cold fast and a missed call is a lost booking. Ladder mined from the HVAC pack.
steps: Immediate SMS: sorry we missed you, what date are you looking at?
Increment missed-call tag ladder ops-missed-call-1 / -2 / -3plus
At 3+: internal alert - this person has tried three times

workflows.name: 14. Seasonal Reactivation
workflows._why: Research #5: INQUIRY season is not EVENT season. December corporate work is sold in Aug-Oct, the deadest Gulf South event months.
steps: Aug-Oct: corporate holiday party outreach to past corporate contacts
Jan-Feb: spring wedding and graduation outreach
Mar-Apr: graduation and end-of-school outreach
Sep: fall fundraiser and charity season outreach
workflows.note: The month model in the research is an explicit HYPOTHESIS - validate against the operator's own booking history before trusting it.

_build_order: 1, 2, 5, 6 first - these are the booking spine and the client's stated requirement
12 and 13 next - they stop leads falling on the floor
_spec_standard: STANDARD for every workflow spec and AI prompt: numbered step labels (1, 2, 3; 4a/4b inside branches) typed onto the step in GHL; every SMS with full body; every email with from name, from email, subject, preview text and body as HTML with NO inline styling. build_guide.py enforces this in every prompt's Output section.
